gold: Right Bundle Branch Block (RBBB) with cardiac arrest due to hypoxemia from COPD exacerbation

selector.rationale: Patient had shortness of breath for 2 days prior to presentation and was found unresponsive, with a family member witnessing him struggling for air before losing consciousness, indicating a hypoxemic event leading to cardiac arrest

rejected.label: Brugada syndrome
rejected.why: Lack of strong evidence and specific ECG findings

rejected.label: Right ventricular hypertrophy
rejected.why: Insufficient evidence to support this diagnosis as the primary cause

rejected.label: Acute coronary syndrome
rejected.why: Coronary angiography showed no acute occlusions, contradicting this diagnosis

rejected.label: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) exacerbation
rejected.why: While patient has COPD, the immediate cause of cardiac arrest appears to be hypoxemic
